output.headline: Growth equity investor with a provider-heavy record and pricing history above the comparable-deal 75th percentile, suited to a 16.8% margin Midwest asset.
output.differentiator: Pays a median 16.5x, above the comparable-deal 75th percentile of 15.3x, with 9 of 14 deals in provider businesses. [V:comps, A:angles]
output.why_them: Provider specialist; has paid above the comparable 75th percentile

acquirer_overview.title: Growth equity firm with a provider-heavy 14-deal record
points: Growth equity firm investing across Technology, Consumer, Financial Services, Healthcare and Life Sciences; AUM US$125.3 billion (infobox). [P:1, P:2]
14 deals from 2019 to 2024; 13 of 14 (93%) closed, and all were control deals. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
Median deal $158M, within a range of $7M to $4,563M; 3 of 14 deals sit in the $100M-$400M band. [T:record, K:size_band]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Provider specialist with a size fit and two Midwest deals
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors are a modest factor in its likelihood: 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors. [S:sector_rel, T:record]
Revenue synergies (Market Share) drove 5 of 14 deals and cost synergies and scale another 5 of 14. [M:market_share, M:scale]
Its angles are provider specialist and size fit; with no open platform, the target would be a new investment rather than an add-on. [A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: Precedents run from a same-sub-sector merger to mid-size provider buyouts
points: Oak Health: $1,708M merger of equals, 2021, 18.8x EV/EBITDA, in the target's own sub-sector. [D:MA-2021-0066]
Crest Medical Practice: $121M leveraged buyout, 2023, 11.5x, a physician group inside the comparable size band. [D:MA-2023-0499]
Harbor Home Health Partners: $15M strategic acquisition, 2022, 16.9x, a Midwest home health deal. [D:MA-2022-0273]

valuation_context.title: 75th percentile is defensible on margin and on this buyer's history
points: 70 comparable deals in the $100M-$400M band: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th percentile. [V:comps]
Target margin of 16.8% beats the comps' median of 12.9% and exceeds 87% of comps, supporting the 75th percentile; $13.1M EBITDA is needed there. [V:comps]
Its median paid of 16.5x exceeds that level. At 5.0x leverage and a $128M equity cheque, max price is $193M (same exit) or $216M (platform exit). [V:comps, V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: At the same exit the maximum is $193M, below the $200M target value; the bid needs the platform exit. [V:lbo, X:target]

risk_flags.title: Thin own-sub-sector record
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector; share of deals there is a slight factor against. [T:record, S:sector_share]
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 adjacent provider deals, and sub-sector relatedness is a modest factor for it. [T:record, S:sector_rel]
risk_flags.reality: No open platform, so there is no add-on logic; conviction stays Medium. [A:angles]

risk_flags.title: Broad mandate, one terminated deal
risk_flags.concern: Healthcare is one of five sectors, and 5 of 14 deals were outside provider services. [P:1, T:record]
risk_flags.reality: The 2021 Frontier Clinics platform investment was terminated. [D:MA-2021-0337]

conviction.rationale: Supported by 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; held back because there is no open platform in the sub-sector. [T:record, A:angles]
